ModMetaData.name: Better Attack Orders for Simple Sidearms
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_BAO.png[/img]
RimWorld mod that extends a pawn's target scanning to consider targets within reach of the sidearms it carries through [url=https://github.com/PeteTimesSix/SimpleSidearms]Simple Sidearms[/url].
[h1]Features[/h1] [list] [*]Ranged attack orders consider every carried sidearm, not just the equipped weapon: if only a carried sidearm can reach the target, the order swaps to it and fires. No new buttons. [*]A drafted pawn standing guard with nothing in its equipped weapon's range draws a carried weapon that can reach a target, then engages. [/list]
[h1]Load order[/h1] Harmony, then Simple Sidearms, then this mod.
[h1]My other mods[/h1] [b]The CE + Simple Sidearms suite[/b] - a compatibility patch making Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms work together, plus the modules that build on it. [table] [tr][th]Module[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Patch.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Core compatibility patch for Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Loadouts][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Loadouts.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Syncs loadouts between Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Tactics][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Tactics.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Sensible tweaks to nonsense pawn behavior when CE + SS run together.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[b]Standalone[/b] - none of these need the patch, or each other. [table] [tr][th]Mod[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/Pawns-Optimize-Weapon-Quality][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_POWQ.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Pawns upgrade their held guns when a higher-quality copy is available.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/Universal-Patch-for-More-Materials][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_UPMM.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Adds materials from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3055040889]More Materials[/url] to non-vanilla recipes.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h1]FAQ[/h1] [b]CE compatible?[/b] Yup!
[b]Can I add or remove it mid-save?[/b] Yep.
[b]Does it change balance?[/b] It simplifies and automates aspects of combat weapon management.
[b]AI?[/b] This mod was engineered with the help of an AI Coding Assistant (Claude Code, Fable 5, Max effort). The amount of researching and deep-diving the compatibility interfaces of the mods it patches would have been insurmountable without it.
Development followed a standard process driven and scrutinized by me (the real human person writing this): explore, design, build, test, fix, review, scrutinize, test again over many rounds.
I have manually reviewed and verified all code in this mod.
I ask that if you have unconstructive feedback regarding the usage of AI while developing this mod, that it remains outside of this community space. Thank you.
